assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: original large endpoint illustration for a fantasy roguelike game's parchment route map.
Style: match the dark brown hand-inked medieval symbols in the game's atlas visible in context: bold uneven contours, solid chunky dark-umber shapes, cut-out transparent highlights, only a few simple interior strokes. This is readable map icon artwork, not a painted scene or polished vector logo. Flat 2D, slightly irregular pixel-game ink edges.
Palette: exclusively very dark warm brown ink (#301600); transparent negative space is used for all highlights and background. No opaque white or beige fills, no parchment background, no gradients, no shadows.
Composition: single centered wide silhouette, approximately 4:3 subject aspect, fully visible with 7 percent clear outer padding. Readable when shown about 320 pixels wide.
Constraints: genuinely transparent background, no text, no UI, no border or enclosing badge, no arrows or paths, no labels, no checkerboard drawn into the image. Original artwork, do not reproduce Slay the Spire artwork.
Primary request: a welcoming expedition base camp that marks the START of a journey. Draw one sturdy medieval adventurer tent in the middle with an open entrance, a short pennant above it, two small travelling supply bundles and a few rocks along the foot. The tent and supplies form one compact unified vignette with a clear grounded base, not multiple separate icons. Keep the ink silhouette simple and chunky like the tent symbol in the game's atlas. There are no people. This is an expedition camp, distinct from the small campfire room symbol.
